title: paramarthacarca — par-p08
question: This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds.
